title: RunnerAdvance
description: spec §4.3. from 0 = batter's box; to 4 = scored. from==to records surviving a play (e.g., rundown) attributed to a misplay.

cause.description: what happened to the *ball*, when `reason` says only why the runner was entitled to move (§13.2). The case that needs it is the dropped third strike: `reason` must stay `dropped_third_strike` for the batting line, so the getaway has nowhere else to live. Absent means the ball did not get away — she reached on an error (see `enabledByTouchId`) or simply beat the throw. Never inferred: the scorer says which, always.
